label: Whatever HAS_INTELLECT_1 lives
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever has intellect lives (operates from itself). After ST I q.18 a.3, where understanding is the highest grade of life and life is grounded in intellect. Not identified with STMT-PURE-ACT-LIVES (time-indexed, from the absence of potency) or STMT-THINKER-LIVES (bearers of occurring thoughts).
